text:
The engineer’s deposition is inadmissible as hearsay not within any recognized exception. Former testimony does not apply: the company examined him in the wrongful-termination case, but it lacked a similar motive to develop the structural-defect facts now offered on strict products liability. No other exception applies; he was no longer an employee, so the statement is not a party-opponent admission, and it was not against his own interest.

CONFIDENCE: 84
